# JOURNAL — optimizer handover (append-only, whole run)

YOU (the optimizer) own this file. It is the running, accumulating handover across ALL iterations — accepted AND rejected — and it is NEVER reset. Each iteration you APPEND one new entry at the bottom (under the marker line); you do NOT edit or delete earlier entries. Read the whole journal before proposing, so you build on EVERY prior attempt (not just the last accepted one) and never re-test a refuted idea.

You CANNOT know your own gate result while you write — the harness scores you AFTER you stop and stamps a **RESULT** line (outcome + Δ + the tasks you measurably broke/fixed, plus the ones whose move was too small to resolve) right below your entry. So do NOT write 'what worked' as a guess. To learn what actually worked, READ the framework RESULT lines of prior entries (and LEDGER.md): an entry whose RESULT says `rejected` with `broke={...}` tells you which specific edits to drop or redesign — its diff.patch is in ./prior_iterations/<id>/.

Append your entry for THIS iteration below the marker, using this shape (INTENT only — the framework appends the RESULT):

    ## Iteration <your candidate id> — <one-line headline of what you tried>
    - Changes I made (1 line per edit; name the file/tool + cluster it targets):
    - Per change, the EXPECTED effect + why it's safe (which failing task it should fix;
      why no passing task changes behavior):
    - Building on prior RESULTS: which prior entries' broke/fixed I used, and what I
      did NOT re-try because a prior RESULT showed it regressed (cite ids):
    - Refuted hypotheses (a prior RESULT proved this is NOT the fix — never re-test):
    - High-value clusters still NOT cracked (and the guard/tool designs already tried):
    - Plateau signal (are the last few RESULTs flat/negative? if so, which LEVER to switch
      to — e.g. a NEW composite tool instead of another guard, or prompt instead of code):
    - Cost-reduction opportunity (if `cost`/`latency`/`num_messages` is a declared objective,
      run `detect_loop_patterns.py --run-dir $R --tag $BEST --split val` — free, no extra
      eval — and check its `by_tool` map for a same-tool-called-N-times-in-a-row pattern. A
      hit names the exact tool + repeat count: propose a composite/bulk tool (capability
      `tools`), a bundled script entrypoint (`skills-package`), or upfront-batched
      instructions (`prompt`/`system-prompt`) that replace the N calls with one. No hit
      (or cost/latency not a declared objective): say so plainly, do not leave this blank):
    - Focus next iteration:

## Iteration cand_0001 — policy guards in write tools + schedule enrichment + time filter
- Changes I made (tools/tools.py):
  1. cancel_reservation: required `reason` + in-body eligibility guard (flown→refuse/transfer; else allow iff ≤24h, airline-cancelled segment, business, or insurance+health/weather) [cluster A: 35, 42, 44].
  2. get_reservation_details: returns dict with `flight_schedule` (dep/arr, duration, status per segment) [B: 44].
  3. update_reservation_flights: refuse flight changes on basic_economy (same-flight cabin change allowed) [C: 23].
  4. book_reservation: ≤1 certificate / ≤1 credit card / ≤3 gift cards guard [D: 20, 23]; payment-not-found error lists available ids [F: 35]; total_baggages doc = user-stated bags with example [E: 8, 35].
  5. search_direct_flight / search_onestop_flight: optional `depart_after` [G: 20].
- Expected effect + safety: 35 should stop cancelling M20IZO (gold: no cancel); 42 blocks HTR26G (4/5 trials); 44 should no longer transfer and S61CZX cancel is blocked; 23 gets "basic economy cannot be changed" → cancel+rebook path; 20 t2-type double-certificate blocked. Passing task 10 never cancels/books and its reservation is economy, so guards are silent; only the extra schedule fields reach it.
- Building on prior RESULTS: none (first iteration).
- Refuted hypotheses: none yet.
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: 42 trip-conflict reasoning (agent also cancels eligible but unrelated business reservations); 23 multi-reservation split-payment plan (communicate '1286').
- Plateau signal: n/a.
- Cost-reduction opportunity: cost/latency not a declared objective; not run.
- Focus next iteration: read RESULT; if 10 regressed, suspect get_reservation_details enrichment (only edit reaching it). Then 42 reasoning (maybe a reservation-overlap helper) and 23 split payment.

> **RESULT (framework, measured):** ACCEPTED (new champion) · val=0.571 Δ=+0.286 · fixed={20} · broke={—} · unresolved={10, 44, 8} (moved less than 2·SE of its own measurement — NOT evidence the edit touched those tasks; do not redesign on them).
<!-- cand_0001: ACCEPTED val=0.571 Δ=+0.286 -->

## Iteration cand_0002 — quote tool + expected_charge guard, cabin-change composite, overlap finder, split-reservation knowledge
- Changes I made (tools/tools.py):
  1. NEW READ `quote_reservation_update(reservation_id, cabin, flights=None)` — exact price via shared `_price_flight_update` helper [A/B: 10, 44].
  2. `update_reservation_flights` new required `expected_charge`; refuses with the real amount when it mismatches [A: 10 t1/t4].
  3. NEW WRITE `change_reservation_cabin(reservation_id, cabin, payment_id, expected_charge)` — keeps flights in code [C: 44 t4].
  4. `get_reservation_details.allowed_modifications` + basic-economy error points to cabin-change path [C: 44 t2/t4].
  5. book_reservation: separate-reservations-per-passenger is allowed (doc + error note only when >1 passenger) [D: 23]; seats not assigned here [E: 8]; never copy bags from another reservation [F: 35 t4].
  6. transfer_to_human_agents: narrowing — no transfer for denied requests (except flown→cancel), user refusal, price quotes, seats [E: 8 t0, 35 t1, 44 t1].
  7. NEW READ `find_overlapping_reservations(user_id)` [G: 42 t2].
  8. Bug fix: cand_0001 left the gift-card/certificate balance check inside the limits loop (only the last method was checked); moved into the per-method loop.
- Expected effect + safety: 10 → guard reveals the real $1302/$2010 (> user's $1000) so the user declines (gold = no write); 44 → agent can quote and upgrade BE reservations; 23 → agent accepts the 3-reservation split (gold DB reproduced in script); 42 → only real conflicts listed. Passing task 20: single passenger, book only — gold booking DB identical; no update/transfer path.
- Building on prior RESULTS: kept all cand_0001 guards (ACCEPTED, fixed={20}). Nothing has been rejected yet.
- Refuted hypotheses: none.
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: 23 t4 agent changes route (SEA) when searching "cheapest"; 23 '1286' communicate requires summing 3 card charges; 44 "≤3h" interpretation (gold counts per flight).
- Plateau signal: n/a (1 accept).
- Cost-reduction opportunity: cost/latency not a declared objective; not run.
- Focus next iteration: read RESULT; if 44/10 regress, suspect the required expected_charge param (could make it Optional as fallback). Then 23 route/communication.

> **RESULT (framework, measured):** ACCEPTED (new champion) · val=0.800 Δ=+0.229 · fixed={—} · broke={—} · unresolved={10, 20, 35, 42, 44, 8} (moved less than 2·SE of its own measurement — NOT evidence the edit touched those tasks; do not redesign on them).
<!-- cand_0002: ACCEPTED val=0.800 Δ=+0.229 -->

## Iteration cand_0003 — airport-code guard, price-sorted search tool, change-payment rule/receipt, per-flight durations
- Changes I made (tools/tools.py):
  1. `_check_airport_code` guard in search_direct_flight / search_onestop_flight: non-airport codes (NYC) raise an actionable error with suggestion; lowercase normalized [B: 20 t1].
  2. NEW READ `search_flights_by_price(origin, destination, date, cabin, passengers, depart_after)` — direct + one-stop merged, seat-filtered, sorted, ranked [C: 23 t1].
  3. `payment_rule` in quote_reservation_update; `payment_made` receipt (dict return) in update_reservation_flights / change_reservation_cabin; payment_id docs: one card/gift card, no certificates, no split [D: 23 t1].
  4. `flight_durations` (each flight + longest_single_flight) in get_reservation_details + per-flight worked example [A: 44 all trials].
- Expected effect + safety: 20 retries with JFK → gold; 23 sees upgrade must be paid fully by Mastercard → chooses cancel+rebook with correct cheapest flights → gold; 44 upgrades NM1VX1+KC18K6+H8Q05L. All additive/bounded: guard only fires on codes absent from DB; new tool reproduces gold for passing 35 (rank 2); no passing task has a duration condition or a cabin-change payment.
- Building on prior RESULTS: kept all cand_0001/0002 guards (both ACCEPTED, broke={}).
- Refuted hypotheses: none (no rejects yet).
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: 44 user-sim sometimes insists on summed totals (unfixable by tools).
- Plateau signal: n/a (two accepts).
- Cost-reduction opportunity: cost/latency not a declared objective; not run.
- Focus next iteration: if 44 still 0, inspect whether agent read flight_durations; if 35 moved, check search_flights_by_price ranking use.

> **RESULT (framework, measured):** ACCEPTED (new champion) · val=0.914 Δ=+0.114 · fixed={—} · broke={—} · unresolved={20, 23, 44} (moved less than 2·SE of its own measurement — NOT evidence the edit touched those tasks; do not redesign on them).
